coefficient_ring: The proposed word must be valid over Z[N]/(N^3-1), or its rational extension. The lower bound uses the necessary specialization to Q(zeta). No positive primitive-component identity is promoted to a full-ring identity.
coverage: Written all-word/all-n proofs, with finite exact identity and negative-control fixtures. No exhaustive search, formal-kernel proof, positive scalar caller, or native admission is claimed.

four_pure_layer_gate.proof: Every adjacent two-layer product must have trace0. Equal-type neighboring layers have trace n-3*zeta*s or n-3*zeta^2*s with rational s, impossible. Types must alternate. Coefficient comparison gives D(2A+B+3AB)=A+AB; multiply right by B and use D^2=0 to force AB=0, contradicting the first pair trace0.
four_pure_layer_gate.scope: Mixed N and N^2 coefficients within a layer are outside this pure-layer argument.
four_pure_layer_gate.statement: No four layers, each entirely I+(zeta-1)A_l or entirely I+(zeta^2-1)A_l with rational A_l^2=0, multiply to zeta I_n for n>0.

general_bound.written_proof: README.md, general interaction-matrix argument. Valid for every finite n and k in the stated model, not a search result.

model: n independent banks; each paid query is Eij(+-N) or Eij(+-N^2); constant rational GL_n bridges are free. Equivalently normalized directions u_i,v_i are constant rational and v_i^T u_i=0. Arbitrary operator-dependent directions, or unrelated polynomial query coefficients, are outside this wide bound.

projection_control.warning: This fixture does not assert equal row/column spaces. Their equality is the contradictory hypothesis in the written all-word proof.

pure_four_layer_control.forced_hypothetical_relation: If target defect vanishes, D(2A+B+3AB)=A+AB, so 2DAB=AB; D^2=0 forces AB=0.
pure_four_layer_control.warning: The finite fixture does not solve the target. It checks the algebra used in the written all-n obstruction.

remaining: Four matching layers with mixed N/N^2 coefficients inside a layer are not excluded by these gates.
A four-layer construction must still give every bank its full native endpoint, source-code transport, literal inverse and complete scalar/native/idle invoice.

three_matching_layer_gate.proof: For P=(I+A2)(I+A1), tr(P)=tr(P^-1). The target gives P=zeta(I-A3), hence tr(P)=n*zeta and tr(P^-1)=n*zeta^-1, a contradiction.
three_matching_layer_gate.scope: Constant scalar bridges may occur between layers. Arbitrary mixing inside a nominal layer is outside the squarezero-layer premise unless that premise is separately proved.
three_matching_layer_gate.statement: No three normalized layers I+A_l with A_l^2=0 can multiply to zeta I_n in characteristic0.
